Mette Astrup Tolver is a consultant physician (overlæge) and a member of the steering committee ([[styregruppen|Styregruppen]]) for the Acute Surgery Database [^src1]. She serves as a representative for the Danish Surgical Society (Dansk Kirurgisk Selskab) and Zealand University Hospital Køge (Sjællands Universitetshospital, Køge) within Region Zealand (Region Sjælland) [^src1]. Through her position on the steering committee, she contributes to the regional implementation of the database's clinical quality indicators [^src1].

Her work is situated within the broader context of the 2025 annual report for the Acute Surgery Database, which details structured comments from Danish regions and hospitals regarding quality indicators for acute surgery, particularly perforated ulcers [^src1]. The report discusses organizational governance via the steering committee and highlights systemic barriers to quality measurement, including registration challenges and the need to adjust targets according to varying hospital functions [^src1]. As a key representative for Region Zealand, Tolver is part of the interdisciplinary and regional initiatives striving to overcome these barriers and improve acute surgical care [^src1].
